articles.title: Chicago White Sox drop out of 1st in AL Central with 6-3 loss
articles.description: The Chicago White Sox fell into second place in the AL Central with a 6-3 loss to the Cleveland Guardians on Wednesday. With 10 games left, they trail the Guardians by a half-game.

articles.title: Chicago White Sox recall lefty Noah Schultz from Triple-A Charlotte as a multi-inning relief option
articles.description: The Chicago White Sox recalled 2022 first-round draft pick Noah Schultz from Triple-A Charlotte on Tuesday. The Oswego East product could be used in a multi-inning relief role.
